name: St Vincent de Paul, Over Hulton

boundary.description: From the point where Bolton – Salford District crosses M61 Motorway, S along the district boundary to and W along Wigan – Bolton boundary, then by W boundary of Westhoughton Civil Parish to and E along the M61 Motorway to the point where it crosses Bolton-Slaford District boundary.

supplementaryNote.title: The Civil Parish boundary can be described as follows:
supplementaryNote.text: From the point on the Bolton - Salford District boundary, opposite Oxford Road and by a bee-line N including Rawsthorne Wood and Markland plantation and excluding Brancker Street, crossing Manchester Road (A6) and Punch Lane to M61 Motorway (excluding junction 5 slip roads).
